create_MobileNetV2ImageProcessor: create a MobileNetV2ImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images with ImageNet normalization
preprocess_images_MobileNetV2ImageProces: preprocess a batch of images through MobileNetV2ImageProcessor with resize, crop, rescale, and normalize
preprocess_segmentation_maps_MobileNetV2: preprocess segmentation maps alongside images using MobileNetV2ImageProcessor with nearest interpolation
reduce_label_MobileNetV2ImageProcessor: reduce label values by 1 in segmentation maps, replacing background 0 with 255
post_process_semantic_segmentation_Mobil: post-process semantic segmentation logits from MobileNetV2ForSemanticSegmentation into pixel-level maps
